episodes.187577: An EF-0 tornado caused some minor damage to the west northwest of Lake Jackson.
episodes.188237: Several waterspouts were observed southwest of Key West in association with convective rain showers.  Strong high pressure was located over the western north Atlantic with a deepening low pressure system near the mouth of the Mississippi River.
episodes.188492: A pair of weak low pressure systems moved from coastal Texas to Louisiana. Showers and a few stronger storms affected the coast with higher wind gusts.

events.narrative: As a late night cold front moved across Southeast Texas, a brief EF-0 tornado formed on the southeast side of the Brazoria Reservoir and damaged some trees and power lines. There was also minor structural damage to some nearby homes.
